# MoeKey

> MoeKey is an open-source, cross-platform Misskey client built with Flutter. It brings Misskey-style browsing, posting, and social interaction to Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Official website: https://moekey.moegirl.love/
Source repository: https://github.com/MoeKeyDev/MoeKey

MoeKey supports home, local, social, and global timelines; posting with attachments, replies, quote renotes, polls, and emoji reactions; multiple accounts and profile editing; following and notifications; Drive files and clips; and note/user search and discovery. The website is available in Chinese, English, and Japanese.

Downloads are published as GitHub Release assets. The latest-release link always points to the current published version; the main branch contains the current source code. Release notes describe the changes included in each release.

- [Website overview](https://moekey.moegirl.love/index.md): A Markdown version of the homepage, including supported features and platform downloads.

- [Chinese project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MoeKeyDev/MoeKey/main/README.zh_CN.md): Project introduction and feature information in Simplified Chinese.
